steps.action: Register step 1: open Entities; its first view is Calendar; select List
steps.expected: Entities opens on the Compliance calendar; List shows the registry table.

steps.action: Register step 2: Search entities by name; Filter with Type, Status, Jurisdiction, Majority owner (one value, Apply, chips); Clear all
steps.expected: Search narrows by name; each filter takes one value and shows a chip; Clear all removes every filter.

steps.action: Register step 5: a type whose Form requires a Field for creation shows it after the identity details; blank gives 'Fill {Field}'; filled, it saves
